config.phase: Development screen on all 96 fixed persona x mechanism x on/off contexts. Three arms, 288 calls. No policy-effect scoring.
config.primary: First-response strict schedule valid >=95%, no request failures, no confirmed unsupported policy benefit or invented memory. Any flagged fact requires source review. Incomplete generation is failure. Fixed minimum 20-minute gaps; no hidden timing repair.
config.selection: Eligibility by contract and fact grounding, then lowest token cost. Never rank candidates by treatment effect. Attribute v15 thinking vs non-thinking to decoding mode; v11 vs v15 thinking to prompt under common settings.
config.confirmation: After candidate is frozen, untouched 24-person dataset and new independent seeds; no retuning on confirmation. Four already-seen synthetic constraints remain development regression checks.
config.safety: No DB access or writes. Raw responses fsync each cell. Do not overwrite/retry. P010 immutable; P015 not run; no policy-specific action directions or empirical effect targets in universal prompts.
config.stop_rule: Complete registered matrix. Failed candidates lead to a separately versioned development trial. Do not call a format gate macroeconomic validation.
